_comment: AC3 (st_dd0e19d8) — the explicit written list that decides what reaches the published copy. Path globs only; no owner data may enter this file, it is tracked and it ships. Glob syntax and the lock's meaning are documented in lib/publication-manifest.js. Regenerate the lock with `node scripts/publication-manifest.js --write-lock` IN THE SAME COMMIT that adds or removes a tracked file; a stale lock refuses publication by design.

include.reason: Everything git tracks is the universe. The guarantee comes from the exclusions below plus the lock, not from a narrow include: a narrow include silently drops a file the product needs and the failure shows up as a broken published copy rather than as a refusal.

exclude.reason: The owner's decision at scope: the published version excludes the test suite. By DIRECTORY at any depth — 666 tracked files sit under a tests/ directory, including scripts/qa/tests/.

The same decision by FILE SHAPE, which is the half a directory rule misses: one tracked test file (scripts/qa/regression-rag-embed-divergence.test.js) lives outside every tests/ directory and a directory-only rule would have shipped it.
The second test-file shape. No tracked file matches it today; the rule exists so a future .spec.js does not become the next file that ships because nobody re-derived the exclusion.
